collections['732f159c-168d-423e-a730-b4011969d539']?.['data']?.[0] 
  ? (
       collections['732f159c-168d-423e-a730-b4011969d539']?.['data']?.[0]?.['mode']  == "annales"
        ? (
            "Concours "
            +
            (
               collections['19277214-0110-41c3-836c-b88bc75da7fe']?.['data'] ?.find(
                e =>
                  e.id ===
                  collections.current_quiz_session.data[0].ecole_id
              )?.nom || ""
            )
            +
            " "
            +
            (collections.current_quiz_session.data[0].year || "")
          )
        : (
            (
              collections.current_quiz_session.data[0].mode === "qcm_court"
                ? "QCM Court"
                : collections.current_quiz_session.data[0].mode === "qcm_theme"
                  ? "QCM par thème"
                  : collections.current_quiz_session.data[0].mode === "concours_blanc"
                    ? "Concours blanc"
                    : ""
            )
            +
            " - "
            +
            (
              collections.ecoles.data?.find(
                e =>
                  e.id ===
                  collections.current_quiz_session.data[0].ecole_id
              )?.nom || ""
            )
          )
    )
  : ""
